neighbours.label: menu-path and command tokens in Arduino / embedded-board setup instructions (Tools > Board)
fire: Plug in the board, then in the Arduino IDE pick Tools > Port and the right COM port.
To flash the sketch, open the Arduino software and choose Tools > Board > Arduino Nano.
Before uploading, select Tools > Programmer > AVRISP mkII in the Arduino IDE.
In the Arduino editor go to Sketch > Include Library > Manage Libraries.
Connect the Uno over USB and select the board from the Tools > Board menu of the Arduino app.
For the ESP32, open the Arduino IDE and set Tools > Upload Speed to 115200.
After installing the core, choose Tools > Board > Digispark in the Arduino environment.
If the upload fails, check Tools > Port again in the Arduino IDE and retry.
quiet: To change the font, open Microsoft Word and choose Format > Font.
In Photoshop pick Image > Adjustments > Levels to fix the contrast.
In Excel go to Data > Sort and pick the column you want.
To print, open the browser and choose File > Print from the menu.
In Outlook select Tools > Options and open the Mail tab.
In the photo app choose Edit > Rotate to fix the picture.
Open Firefox and set Settings > Privacy to strict mode.
In PowerPoint pick Insert > Picture to add an image to the slide.
